g.text: One world, one pilot. Fixed T2 and T4 examples; all 15 sessions are reported separately.
Arrows are actual moves; numbers preserve movement order. Node operations are listed beneath each graph.
Incomplete paths end where the native agent stopped. These observations alone do not establish a memory effect.
